# @dpup/meshcore-ts

> Typed, ergonomic TypeScript client for MeshCore Companion Radio devices over
> TCP/WiFi or USB serial. A thin wrapper over @liamcottle/meshcore.js that adds
> named events, typed data models, normalized values (hex-string keys, Date
> timestamps), typed errors, and request timeouts. ESM-only, Node ≥ 18.

Primary API surface is a single class, `MeshCoreClient`, created via
`MeshCoreClient.tcp(host, port)` or `MeshCoreClient.serial(path)`. It is a typed
event emitter; subscribe with `client.on("<event>", …)`. Inputs that take a
contact accept a `Contact`, a hex public-key string, or `Uint8Array`.

## Docs

- [API reference](docs/api.md): Complete, generated reference — every method, event, model, error, and enum with full signatures and types. Source of truth.
- [Guide](docs/guide.md): Concepts and recipes — connecting, events & auto-sync, messaging, contacts, errors/timeouts, remote nodes, the raw escape hatch.
- [README](README.md): Overview, install, quickstart, and design philosophy.

## Examples

- [list-contacts](examples/list-contacts.ts): Connect, print self info, list contacts.
- [monitor](examples/monitor.ts): Live, color-coded traffic monitor for a node.

## Notes

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Architecture, conventions, and gotchas for working in this repo.
- The reference (docs/api.md) is generated by `bun run docs` and CI-verified to stay in sync with the source; treat it as authoritative over any prose.
